{{Top}}
{{Quote|When [Padmé Amidala] talked about the past it seemed real, you know? The suffering before the Great Time of Peace wasn't ancient history, but just ''yesterday'', and the people who lived through it mattered.|[[Ian Lago]]|<ref name="A Summer's Dream">{{Tales|5|A Summer's Dream}}</ref>}}
The '''Great Time of Peace''' on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] began with the rise of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]], who united the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] around [[832 BBY/Legends|832 BBY]]. Before this, Naboo had known a long period of conflict, known as the [[Time of Suffering/Legends|Time of Suffering]], that started circa [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and engulfed all the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] city-states. Each Naboo [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]] has worn the [[Scar of remembrance/Legends|scar of remembrance]] ever since as a reminder of this dark time. As a result of the unification, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], originally a farming community, became the Royal capital, eclipsing the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]]. The Great Time of Peace did not end until the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockaded]] the planet in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] during the reign of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]].
